name: Femboy Sorority
source:
The main character has transferred from the engineering class to the art class , deciding to finally pursue the hobby his been hiding from everyone. Around the same time, his childhood friend has enrolled in the same college. The story begins exactly one day before that moment.

[From [url=https://jayas-dawn.itch.io/femboy-sorority]Itch[/url]]
translation:
主角从工科班转到了美术班，终于下定决心去追逐那个自己一直瞒着所有人的爱好。几乎在同一时间，他的青梅竹马也考入了同一所大学。而故事，正是在那一刻到来的前一天拉开了帷幕。

[摘自[url=https://jayas-dawn.itch.io/femboy-sorority]itch.io[/url]]
